capabilities: Hide text inside a collapsible codeblock section
Reveal hidden content by clicking a button
Use LaTeX and other Obsidian features inside hidden sections
extras: README is short and informal; usage is shown mainly through screenshots described in text, with codeblock construction shown only as code examples.
motivation: The author intends to use it to hide away ugly mathematical proofs so documents stay readable while keeping the proof one click away for exam preparation.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep verbose but occasionally needed content, such as mathematical proofs, out of view without deleting it.

relations.evidence: thanks to AllJavi/spoiler-block-obsidian for code sample

summary: Plugin that hides selected text in collapsible codeblock sections that stay folded until revealed with a click, with LaTeX support.
